                 format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Select all aluminum atoms
aluminum = u.select_atoms('type 1')

# Compute the MSD
msd = EinsteinMSD(aluminum, msd_type='xyz', fft=true)
msd.run()

# Extract the time and MSD values
time = msd.times
msd_values = msd.results.msd

# Ignore the first 50 ps (50000 timesteps)
valid_indices = time > 50
valid_time = time[valid_indices]
valid_msd = msd_values[valid_indices]

# Identify the melting point as the first frame where MSD shows a sudden jump
melting_point_index = np.argmax(np.diff(valid_msd) > 0.1) + 1  # +1 to get the index after the jump
melting_point_time = valid_time[melting_point_index]

# Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state
# Use the MSD after the detected melting point
diffusion_msd = valid_msd[melting_point_index:]
diffusion_time = valid_time[melting_point_index:]

# Fit a line to the MSD vs time to get the diffusion constant
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(diffusion_time, diffusion_msd, 1)
diffusion_constant = slope / 6  # 6 for 3D diffusion

# Print the diffusion constant
print(f'Diffusion constant: {diffusion_constant:.2e}')

    with open(filename, 'r') as file:

    # Extract atom positions

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):

    for t in range(num_frames):
        displacements = positions[t:] - positions[:-t]
        squared_displacements = np.square(displacements).sum(axis=2)
